option_relations.rationale: The clinical presentation and genetic testing results match the characteristics of Epidermolytic ichthyosis (bullous congenital ichthyosiform erythroderma), which is equivalent to Bullous Congenital Ichthyosiform Erythroderma.
There is no direct relation between Superficial epidermolytic ichthyosis and the provided clinical information.
There is no direct relation between Ichthyosis bullosa of Siemens and the provided clinical information.
There is no direct relation between Annular epidermolytic ichthyosis (AEI) and the provided clinical information.
